newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Foreign Minister Adrian Severin will start a visit to Ukraine on Saturday to initial the Romanian-Ukrainian treaty. Severin will meet Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma.
* The government met for a second working session this week to discuss laws on the banking system.

* Ex-president Ion Iliescu, the leader of Romania's main opposition Party of Social Democracy, congratulated Britain's Tony Blair for winning Thursday's general elections, saying his party hailed the British Labour's victory as a success of social-democratic values.
* Romania is hosting an international conference of agriculture ministers from Central and Eastern Europe. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
